walkthrough:
Determine the total number of balloons and partition into green and non-green:
$$\text{Total} = 10 + 9 + 12 + 9 = 40$$
$$\text{Green} = 12, \quad \text{Non-green} = 40 - 12 = 28$$

Select $7$ balloons without replacement. For exactly $3$ green balloons, we must choose $3$ green balloons from $12$ and $4$ non-green balloons from $28$:
$$\text{Favorable selections} = \binom{12}{3} \times \binom{28}{4}$$
$$\text{Total unrestricted selections} = \binom{40}{7}$$

Evaluate the combination terms and calculate the probability:
$$\mathrm{P}(\text{exactly } 3 \text{ green}) = \frac{\binom{12}{3} \times \binom{28}{4}}{\binom{40}{7}} = \frac{220 \times 20475}{18643560} = \frac{4504500}{18643560} \approx 0.242$$

ai_rubric.Calculating Combinations: Evaluates combinations terms correctly for selection without replacement.

teacher_walkthrough:
Count the total number of balloons in the bag and partition them into green balloons and other balloons:
$$\text{Total balloons} = 10 + 9 + 12 + 9 = 40$$
$$\text{Green balloons} = 12, \quad \text{Other balloons} = 40 - 12 = 28$$
Since $7$ balloons are selected without replacement and exactly $3$ must be green, the remaining $7 - 3 = 4$ balloons must be chosen from the $28$ other balloons.

Apply the classical probability formula using combinations:
$$\mathrm{P}(A) = \frac{n(A)}{n(S)} = \frac{\binom{n_{\text{green}}}{r_{\text{green}}} \times \binom{n_{\text{other}}}{r_{\text{other}}}}{\binom{n_{\text{total}}}{r_{\text{total}}}}$$
Substitute $n_{\text{green}} = 12$, $r_{\text{green}} = 3$, $n_{\text{other}} = 28$, $r_{\text{other}} = 4$, $n_{\text{total}} = 40$, and $r_{\text{total}} = 7$:
$$\mathrm{P}(\text{exactly } 3 \text{ green}) = \frac{\binom{12}{3} \times \binom{28}{4}}{\binom{40}{7}}$$

Multiply the numerator factors and divide by the total number of selections:
$$\mathrm{P}(\text{exactly } 3 \text{ green}) = \frac{220 \times 20475}{18643560} = \frac{4504500}{18643560} \approx 0.24161 \approx 0.242$$
